mapper.select: select id, mission_code as missionCode, mission_name as missionName, mission_desc as missionDesc, case when trigger_event = 'store_verify' then 'store_verify' else trigger_event end as triggerEvent, exp_reward as expReward, daily_limit as dailyLimit, status, sort_no as sortNo, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from growth_mission where mission_code = #{missionCode} and status = '0' limit 1

select id, mission_code as missionCode, mission_name as missionName, mission_desc as missionDesc, case when trigger_event = 'store_verify' then 'store_verify' else trigger_event end as triggerEvent, exp_reward as expReward, daily_limit as dailyLimit, status, sort_no as sortNo, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from growth_mission where trigger_event = #{triggerEvent} and status = '0' order by sort_no asc, id desc
select member_id from cms_registration where id = #{registrationId} and payment_status = 2 and verification_status = 1 limit 1 for update

select id, mission_code as missionCode, mission_name as missionName, mission_desc as missionDesc, trigger_event as triggerEvent, exp_reward as expReward, daily_limit as dailyLimit, status, sort_no as sortNo, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from growth_mission where status = '0' order by sort_no asc, id desc
mapper.insert: insert into growth_mission (mission_code, mission_name, mission_desc, trigger_event, exp_reward, daily_limit, status, sort_no, create_time) values (#{missionCode}, #{missionName}, #{missionDesc}, #{triggerEvent}, #{expReward}, #{dailyLimit}, #{status}, #{sortNo}, #{createTime})
